note: Name patterns (case-insensitive regular expressions) matched against installed app names. 'recommended' items go on the removal list marked for removal; 'questionable' items go on it unmarked, for a yes or no. Nothing is removed unless the list comes back marked.

items.label: McAfee (often a preinstalled trial)
items.why: Trial antivirus that nags for payment and runs beside Microsoft Defender. Keep it only if they pay for it.

items.label: Norton (often a preinstalled trial)
items.why: Trial antivirus that nags for payment. Keep it only if they pay for it.

items.label: WildTangent Games
items.why: Preinstalled game launcher that shows ads.

items.label: ExpressVPN trial
items.why: Often a preinstalled trial. Keep it only if they use it.

items.label: Avast or AVG
items.why: Free antivirus that upsells and has sold browsing data in the past; Microsoft Defender covers the same ground.

items.label: Driver updater
items.why: Driver 'updaters' are a common source of bad drivers and nags; Windows Update supplies drivers.

items.label: PC cleaner or optimizer
items.why: These tools scare people into paying and can break Windows; Storage Sense does the useful part.

items.label: Browser hijacker or bundled toolbar
items.why: Changes the browser's home page and search to show ads.

items.label: PC maker add-on
items.why: Some maker add-ons are useful (driver and firmware updates), others duplicate Windows; decide per PC.
